fit.arithmetic: stdlib fractions.Fraction exact KKT solve + Decimal 1e-6 ROUND_HALF_EVEN quantization
fit.pair_formability_rule: A material pair (m_a, m_b) can form in a task under scenario (pad_class, table_class) iff an episode of that task contains two distinct engine collider bodies b_1 != b_2 carrying m_a and m_b (using asset_id when the asset has material_override, else its assigned material_class) such that at least one of b_1, b_2 is dynamic (Rigid body or robot Articulation link; static Geometry and Scene colliders have RigidBodyAPI disabled/absent and never form static-static contacts in PhysX). It can form a load-bearing contact iff such a body pair exists that is not finger on finger (both bodies gripper finger pads: an empty close, or the grippers of two arms meeting in a handover). Finger-on-finger contact never carries a sliding load these tasks depend on (#167, Bo's side's decision (b)). Any banded pair that cannot form a load-bearing contact in the task (an uncarried class unary, a no_self_contact self-pair, a static-static collider pair, or a finger-on-finger-only pair such as pad_hard__pad_hard) is enforced as a band constraint only and never enters the L2 objective. Across tasks (#59 option 3, #167 decisions 2, 3 and (b)): objective weights come from the committed scripted-solution contact censuses (see PAIR_WEIGHT_RULE): weight 1 iff the pair carries normal load on a non-robot-self body pair in at least one scripted solution, and band-only (weight 0) otherwise.
fit.pair_weight_rule: Presence weighting from the committed scripted-solution contact censuses (#59 option 3, #167 decisions 3 and (b)): a primary-scenario material pair receives weight 1 in the global Stage 1 L2 objective (counted_in_fit_objective = True) iff it can form in at least one task in scope and carries positive normal load (total_normal_impulse_Ns > 0 and actions_force_total > 0 on body pairs that are not robot-link x robot-link) in the committed corrected contact census of at least one task's scripted solution; robot-link x robot-link contacts (finger on finger such as link7|link8 and intra-arm/inter-arm link grazes such as r1.link1|r1.link3) are excluded per #167 decision (b). In Stage 2, each sensitivity-scenario pair (pad_elastomer, table_wood) inherits the presence weight (1 or 0) of its default-scenario counterpart (pad_hard, table_laminate) with Stage 1 classes held fixed. Every weight-0 pair (formable pairs with zero object-contact load in all censused scripts, robot-link x robot-link-only pairs, pairs from tasks without a scripted-solution census yet, and non-formable pairs) is enforced as an exact band constraint only (with 1-hop Fourier-Motzkin cross-band projection in Stages 1-2 and an exact feasible Stage 3 solve for zero-weight classes).
fit.objective: sum_{p in counted_primary_pairs} [(0.5*(u_s[a]+u_s[b]) - nom_s[p])^2 + (0.5*(u_k[a]+u_k[b]) - nom_k[p])^2], where an asset with material_override substitutes its fixed override unary
fit.weights: lexicographic Stage 3a exact feasible solve for censused-task zero-weight classes ['abs_device_housing', 'aluminium', 'ground', 'steel'] (2 active constraints, with exact 1-hop FM cross-band projection from uncensused classes), Stage 3b exact feasible solve for T1 uncensused classes ['engineered_wood', 'foam', 'glazed_ceramic', 'paper_cardboard', 'softwood'] (1 active constraints, with exact 1-hop FM projection from T2 classes) holding Stages 1-3a fixed, and Stage 3c exact feasible solve for T2 uncensused classes ['fabric_textile', 'food_organic', 'glass', 'rubber_elastomer'] (1 active constraints) holding Stages 1-3b fixed
fit.combine_rule: average (PhysX default; 0.5 * (u_a + u_b) on every class)
fit.constraints: all 223 class-pair static/kinetic bands (including exact 1-hop Fourier-Motzkin cross-band projection of zero-weight classes onto Stage 1 and uncensused classes onto Stage 3a) + all 20 asset-override bands + 0 <= u_k <= u_s per class
